title: Canvas layers' elements ignoring visibility of the scene its in when inside of a PackedScene
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.mono.stable

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

I noticed when I tried to hide a scene with canvas elements that it wouldn't actually hide the items inside the canvas layer.
Even after reloading project.

Noteworthy: Only when I go into the saved scene and save it with the canvas hidden / not 'visible', then it will be hidden.
But the main thing is that when the Packed scene (with the movieclip icon) is toggled visible/invisible, that's what seems to be ignored by the canvas inside of that scene.

Issue remains during play, not just in editor.

### Steps to reproduce

I have only tried this with a 3D node as root, I do not know if it applies to 2D yet.

Happens in 4.6.stable.mono (Haven't tried the dev versions of 4.7 yet, but assumed it'd be a bug anyway if it's for stable)

1. Create a 3D world node as root node.
2. Create another 3D Node in there, note this one down as 'TestingNode' or whatever
3. Add a canvas layer to it
4. Add a label to the canvas layer and add some text so you can see the text (In my original project this was not just a label, so it's other elements as well)
5. Save your TestingNode as a scene, and make sure it's loaded as scene in your original root (I think that always goes automatically)
6. Switch to 2D view so you can view your test label
7. Toggle your saved scene (TestingNode)'s visibility icon, voila, your test label will not care, it's always there!
8. Open up the packed scene, toggle visibility off in there, save, and only then it will show the changes in your root.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[testbug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25698813/testbug.zip)
